name: Cleave
description: The second clip is driven into the first like a wedge into a log: a crack runs ahead of its point, the two halves are shoved aside and bunch up against its sides, then fall apart out of the frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction the wedge is driven in, snapped to the nearest of the four edge-to-edge directions (x right, y up)

params.name: opening
params.description: Half angle of the wedge, in degrees

params.name: squash
params.description: How much the halves bunch up against the wedge instead of sliding away rigidly

params.name: shading
params.description: Strength of the ridge and shadow shading along the split
